who: Runs a six-person company that makes software for sailing schools. A sibling gets married in three weeks.

moments.plot: Two good candidates for the first support job, and a wedding in three weeks.

tasks.title: Second call with the Porto candidate
tasks.notes: Ask how they said no to a customer. Let Idris do most of the talking.

tasks.title: Agree the salary range with Idris
tasks.notes: We said a number in September. It was for a different job.

tasks.title: Pick five real tickets for the trial day
Write to the people we said no to
Order a laptop in time for January
Refund the sailing club in Kiel

file.title: Ask the accountant about the trial day
file.notes: Can we pay someone for one day, or does it need a contract?

dated.title: Make the offer
dated.notes: Call first, then send the letter. Idris wants to be on the call.

repeating.title: Week notes to the team
repeating.notes: What shipped, what hurt, one thanks.

attachments.notes: Take out every name. One angry, one confused, one that is our fault, and two easy ones. Idris has the one about the lost bookings.

tasks.title: Send the numbers to the two investors
First draft of the speech
tasks.notes: Not the canoe story. Noor asked twice.

agent.title: Compare three ways to run payroll
agent.notes: Seven people from January, two of them abroad. Monthly cost, and how much of it lands on me.
agent.question: What should decide it?
bodies: The second option is the least work. It files for both countries and needs one approval a month. It costs €84 a month more than the cheapest.
The first option is the cheapest at €126 a month. You would file the Portuguese forms yourself, about four a year.
agent.otherBody: All three can handle seven people in two countries. Looking at it your way: {answer}
agent.acceptance: You know which payroll to set up.

discuss.title: Reply to the candidate who asked for remote
discuss.notes: They want three days at home. We are five at one big table and like it that way.
discuss.question: What do you want to offer?
bodies: Thanks for being so clear about this. We can do two days at home from the start. One day a week we would like everyone at the table.
Thanks for being so clear about this. Let’s try three days at home for the first two months, and then talk about how it went.
discuss.otherBody: Thanks for being so clear about this. Here is what we can do: {answer}
discuss.handoff: Your next step: send it tonight
discuss.acceptance: The candidate knows what we offer.

review.title: Compare three ways to run payroll
review.note: Three options by cost and by work. One price is from a sales page, so ask.

review.title: Sum up the trial day answers
review.note: Both candidates’ five replies, side by side.
